question: What model compression techniques exist for LLMs, and how are compressed LLMs measured?
contributions: First survey dedicated solely to model compression for LLMs
Taxonomy: quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, low-rank factorization
Metrics and benchmarks for compressed LLMs

results.claim: Activation quantization is more sensitive than weight quantization, so weight-only methods reach lower bit widths, but they dequantize before the matmul and cannot use low-bit hardware ops.
Ampere GPUs accelerate only 2:4 semi-structured sparsity.
Choice of calibration data changes downstream accuracy of compressed models significantly.

limits: Tables 1 and 2 copy numbers from the original papers; different models, calibration data and settings, so rows are not comparable head to head.
No experiments run by the survey; speedups are as reported by each method's authors, hardware not stated.
Authors concede compressed LLMs still show a significant performance gap to uncompressed ones and the field is early.
Coverage is up to mid 2024 and shallow per method (one or two sentences each); no recipes or hyperparameters.
Table 1 lists unlabelled rows for QT and ZeroQuant-FP that the text never discusses.
practices: Combine PEFT (QLoRA, PEQA, LoftQ, L4Q) with QAT to cut retraining cost (Remark 1, Sec 3.1).
Treat activation outliers specially (keep in high precision, rescale, or reorder channels) in weight-activation quantization (Sec 3.2.2).
Quantize KV cache keys per-channel and values per-token (KIVI, Sec 3.2.3).
Keep sensitive weights in high precision in weight-only quantization (Sec 3.2.1).
Pick sparsity pattern to match hardware; Ampere accelerates only 2:4 (Sec 4.3).
Combine structured pruning with knowledge distillation to recover accuracy (Remark 2).
Prepare high-quality calibration data for PTQ and pruning (Remark 4).
Use the Roofline model and arithmetic intensity, memory and throughput to assess deployment efficiency (Sec 7.3).

terms.definition: the process of reducing the number of bits (i.e., precision) in the parameters of the model with minimal loss in inference performance.
The primary distinction between the two approaches lies in whether retraining is needed during quantization.
focuses solely on quantizing weights, whereas weight-activation quantization extends its objective to both weights and activations.
targets the KV cache, which stores keys and values of attention layers.
every M contiguous elements leave N non-zero elements

Structured pruning removes entire components like neurons, attention heads, or layers; unstructured prunes individual parameters giving irregular sparsity; semi-structured prunes by specific patterns.
Black-box KD, where only the teacher's outputs are accessible; White-box KD, where the teacher's parameters or output distribution are available.
calculated as the original size divided by the compressed size.
the ratio of the inference time of the uncompressed model over the inference time of the compressed model.
the ratio of actual FLOPS utilized by the LLM to the maximum theoretical FLOPS of a device.
